method: onset aligned; gain normalized; five time windows; 12 partial envelopes; 3 dynamics
limits: Note spectra include room and microphone color; this is not an isolated soundboard measurement.
Velocity labels map to .2/.65/1.0 by convention, not measured hammer speed.
Check pitches are unused in fitting, but use the same instrument and recording sessions.
The aggregate score is not a perceptual realism rating. Some individual cases regress.
reference_filtering: Band, partial, and envelope targets must lie at least 12 dB above the measured pre-strike noise floor. First-pass search steps predate this rule; no new runtime tuning has been adopted.
